description: This file defines the 'AttendanceConfigurationController' class within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. The controller inherits from AbstractVueController and sets up a Vue component called 'attendance-configuration' during the pre-render phase. It facilitates the configuration of attendance settings in the HR system.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the attendance configuration view, extending the abstract Vue controller and initializing the 'attendance-configuration' Vue component during the pre-render phase.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating and setting the Vue component for attendance configuration.
